disease_profile.diagnosis: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) infection, Chronic (Stage 3 / AIDS diagnosis based on history)
disease_profile.stage: CD4 nadir was 180 cells/uL (history of AIDS-defining illness: Pneumocystis pneumonia 2 years ago). Currently stable on ART with CD4 recovered to 520 cells/uL.
disease_profile.treatment_regimen: Biktarvy (bictegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide) -- one tablet daily, taken each morning. Has been on this regimen for 18 months with good adherence.
key_symptoms: Mild peripheral neuropathy in feet (residual from past)
Occasional gastrointestinal discomfort in the mornings
disease_profile.trajectory: Well-controlled on ART. Viral load undetectable for over 12 months. CD4 count steadily improving. Physician has confirmed U=U (undetectable = untransmittable). No opportunistic infections since starting ART. Prognosis is near-normal life expectancy with continued adherence.

demographics.occupation: Graphic designer at a marketing agency
demographics.marital_status: In a relationship, serodiscordant couple (partner is HIV-negative)

causes: His own behavior (not using protection consistently)
Bad luck -- it only takes once
